list.title: How to Use 2.5% Benzoyl Peroxide Body Wash?
list.content:
Step 1
On wet skin, take some body wash in your palms or on a loofah.
Step 2
Massage this benzoyl peroxide body wash into skin using a gentle, circular motion.
Step 3
Once done using this body wash containing benzoyl peroxide, rinse.

list.title: Important Information
list.content:
Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

list.title: Can I use benzoyl peroxide body wash everyday?
list.content: Yes, we recommend using this body wash for back acne once a day, every day.

list.title: Will this body wash remove my back acne and spots?
list.content: This body wash helps calm inflamed skin and prevent formation of back acne.
